combined.scope: all sets; feasible = baseline goodput > 0 (comparison_valid + saturated); discriminating = comparison_valid only

exposes.cb_kv_8k_b32_ramp: 시간에 따라 이동 경로 여유가 줄어드는 경우
exposes.cb_mixed_8k_b32: 객체 종류가 섞여 풀 트래픽·메타데이터 연산이 늘어나는 경우

qa_definitions.goodput: per-request SLO: TTFT <= 2 s and TPOT <= 50 ms; cohort = arrivals after the 10 % warm-up
qa_definitions.qa1: geomean over CB rows of Max SLO Goodput / T_ref; stars 0.90/1.10
qa_definitions.qa2: TTFT/TPOT P99 reported separately; star = worst case over CB rows (own-peak load); *_common = at Baseline-peak load; *_load1 = at x1.0
qa_definitions.qa3: time-average KV residency (P buffer + D HBM + pool) at the Baseline-peak load; saving multiplier = base/cand; stars 0.95/1.25 (temporary definition, qa-criteria-dp4 section 2)
qa_definitions.scalability: Scaling Efficiency values only, no stars
